champions.name: Aatrox
champions.title: the Darkin Blade

passive.name: Deathbringer Stance
passive.desc: Next auto +50 range, deals 4-13% target max HP physical (cap 50 vs monsters). Heals 100%/60%. Champ/large monster hits reduce CD by 3s.

Q.name: The Darkin Blade
Q.desc: 3 sequential casts. Each has a sweetspot dealing 60% bonus damage + 0.25s knockup. Damage escalates per cast.

W.name: Infernal Chains
W.desc: Skillshot that damages and tethers. After 1.5s, pulls target back and deals damage again.

E.name: Umbral Dash
E.desc: Passive: heal for % of non-periodic champion damage dealt. Active: short dash.

R.name: World Ender
R.desc: Fear nearby minions. Gain +25% AD, +50% healing amp. During R, revive on death. 12s duration.

champions.playstyle: Lane bully with teamfight drain-tanking. Land Q sweetspots for knockups and healing.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.title: the Nine-Tailed Fox

passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.desc: After 3 ability hits, next ability heals 40-100 (+20% AP). Takedown within 3s heals 80-200 (+35% AP).

Q.name: Orb of Deception
Q.desc: Throw orb forward dealing magic damage, return deals true damage.

W.name: Fox-Fire
W.desc: Release 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies. +45% MS decaying 1.5s. If AA/Charm within 5s, gains +missile speed +200 radius.

E.name: Charm
E.desc: Skillshot CC that charms enemy, forcing them to walk toward you.

R.name: Spirit Rush
R.desc: 3 dashes, each dealing magic damage. Consuming essence extends recast window and grants additional dashes (up to 3 stored).

champions.playstyle: Safe burst mage with high mobility. Charm to pick targets, Spirit Rush for repositioning.

champions.name: Garen
champions.title: The Might of Demacia

passive.name: Perseverance
passive.desc: Regen 1.3-5.5% missing HP/s after not taking champion/epic/turret damage for 5s.

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.desc: Cleanse slows, +35% MS for 3s. Next auto deals bonus physical + 1.5s silence.

W.name: Courage
W.desc: Passive: +10% bonus armor/MR. Active: 30% damage reduction 4s, 60% tenacity 1s, shield.

E.name: Judgment
E.desc: Spin for 3s dealing physical per tick to nearby enemies. Nearest enemy takes +20% damage. 8+1/level ticks.

R.name: Demacian Justice
R.desc: Execute dealing true damage based on target's missing HP.
R.notes: TRUE DAMAGE. Best used as finisher below 35% HP.

champions.playstyle: Simple lane-dominant juggernaut. Q silence, E spin damage, R true damage execute.

champions.name: Ezreal
champions.title: the Prodigal Explorer

passive.name: Rising Spell Force
passive.desc: Ability hits grant +13% AS per stack, max 4 stacks = 52% bonus AS.

Q.name: Mystic Shot
Q.desc: Skillshot physical damage. Applies on-hit. Reduces other ability CDs by 1.5s on hit.

W.name: Essence Flux
W.desc: Mark target; detonating with ability deals bonus damage and restores mana.

E.name: Arcane Shift
E.desc: Blink to target location + fire homing bolt at nearest enemy.

R.name: Trueshot Barrage
R.desc: Global skillshot dealing AoE magic damage. Reduced per unit hit.

champions.playstyle: Poke ADC with safety blink. Q spam + on-hit build. Global R for assists.

champions.name: Akali
champions.title: the Rogue Assassin

passive.name: Assassin's Mark
passive.desc: After ability, gain MS ring. Crossing it empowers next AA with bonus magic damage + range.

Q.name: Five Point Strike
Q.desc: Throw kunai in arc, dealing magic damage. At 200 energy, heals.

W.name: Twilight Shroud
W.desc: Drop smoke bomb: gain invisibility + MS inside. Extends duration on entering/leaving.

E.name: Shuriken Flip
E.desc: Dash + throw shuriken. Can recast to dash to marked target.

R.name: Perfect Execution
R.desc: 2-part ult: first dash deals physical, second dash deals magic (execute scaling).

champions.playstyle: High-skill AP assassin. Stealth zone allows extended trading. Double-dash R for kill pressure.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.title: the Rogue Sentinel

passive.name: Dirty Fighting
passive.desc: Every 3rd hit deals bonus damage + shield. Cancel AA for double shot.

Q.name: Avengerang
Q.desc: Throw boomerang; extends range on champion hit.

W.name: Going Rogue
W.desc: Passive: revive slain allies when you kill their killer. Active: camouflage.

E.name: Heroic Swing
E.desc: Swing around terrain, shooting at nearest enemy.

R.name: Comeuppance
R.desc: Channel and fire tracking bullets at target.

champions.playstyle: Roaming mid marksman. Unique revive passive rewards tracking kills.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.title: the Minotaur

passive.name: Triumphant Roar
passive.desc: Healing after CC'ing enemies or ally kills. CD reduced by nearby enemy deaths.

Q.name: Pulverize
Q.desc: AoE knockup around self.

W.name: Headbutt
W.desc: Dash to enemy and knock them back.

E.name: Trample
E.desc: AoE magic damage around self. At 5 stacks, next AA stuns.

R.name: Unbreakable Will
R.desc: Cleanse CC + massive damage reduction for 7s.

champions.playstyle: Engage tank support. W+Q combo for reliable knockup. R makes you near-unkillable.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.title: the Matriarch of War

passive.name: Drakehound's Step
passive.desc: After abilities, gain dash toward cursor + empowered AA.

Q.name: Cunning Sweep
Q.desc: Slash in direction dealing physical damage.

W.name: Repudiation
W.desc: Shield + AoE damage. Blocking CC grants bonus shield.

E.name: Lacerate
E.desc: Dash through target dealing damage. Basic attacks on-hit reduce CD.

R.name: Public Execution
R.desc: Suppress target, dash carrying them, then slam dealing damage.

champions.playstyle: Aggressive fighter with energy management. Passive dashes enable relentless aggression.

champions.name: Amumu
champions.title: the Sad Mummy

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.desc: AAs apply Curse, amplifying magic damage dealt to target.

Q.name: Bandage Toss
Q.desc: Skillshot stun + dash to target.

W.name: Despair
W.desc: Toggle AoE dealing %max HP magic damage per second to nearby enemies.

E.name: Tantrum
E.desc: AoE burst. Passive: reduce physical damage taken. CD reduced by hits taken.

R.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
R.desc: Massive AoE stun + magic damage.

champions.playstyle: Teamfight jungle tank. Double Q engages. R is game-winning AoE stun.

champions.name: Annie
champions.title: the Dark Child

passive.name: Pyromania
passive.desc: Every 4th ability stuns. Tibbers aura counts.

Q.name: Disintegrate
Q.desc: Point-click magic damage. Refunds mana on kill.

W.name: Incinerate
W.desc: Cone AoE magic damage.

E.name: Molten Shield
E.desc: Shield + damage reflection + MS. Can cast on ally.

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.desc: Summon Tibbers dealing AoE magic damage. Tibbers attacks and burns.

champions.playstyle: Simple burst mage. Stack passive to 4, Flash+R for AoE stun combo.

champions.name: Ashe
champions.title: the Frost Archer

passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.desc: AAs and abilities slow. Crits deal bonus damage instead of extra crit.

Q.name: Ranger's Focus
Q.desc: Stack 4 flurry stacks. Activate for bonus AS + flurry AAs.

W.name: Volley
W.desc: Fan of arrows in cone. Applies Frost Shot.

E.name: Hawkshot
E.desc: Global vision reveal. Reveals area for several seconds.

R.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
R.desc: Global skillshot stun. Stun duration scales with distance.

champions.playstyle: Utility ADC. Global R for picks. Perma-slow with autos. Hawkshot for vision.

champions.name: Aurelion Sol
champions.title: The Star Forger

passive.name: Cosmic Creator
passive.desc: Abilities grant Stardust stacks that permanently enhance all abilities.

Q.name: Breath of Light
Q.desc: Channel beam dealing magic damage. Stacks Stardust per tick.

W.name: Astral Flight
W.desc: Long-range flight. During flight, Q can be cast. Takedowns reset CD.

E.name: Singularity
E.desc: Place a zone that pulls enemies toward center + deals damage.

R.name: Falling Star / The Skies Descend
R.desc: AoE stun. At 75 Stardust, upgrades to massive knockup + shockwave.

champions.playstyle: Infinite-scaling mage. Farm Stardust stacks. E for roaming. Upgraded R is fight-winning.

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: the Witch Between Worlds

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.desc: AAs and abilities apply marks. At 3 marks, heal and deal bonus magic.

Q.name: Twofold Hex
Q.desc: Fire bolt that resets on hit; can cast twice.

W.name: Across the Veil
W.desc: Enter spirit realm (hop), becoming untargetable briefly + MS burst.

E.name: The Weirding
E.desc: Dash + leave clone behind. Clone mimics last ability.

R.name: Between Worlds
R.desc: Create a massive zone. Enemies inside are slowed; trying to leave are pulled back.

champions.playstyle: Zone control battlemage. W hop for safety. R traps enemies in AoE.

champions.name: Bard
champions.title: the Wandering Caretaker

passive.name: Traveler's Call
passive.desc: Collect chimes for MS + meeps empower AAs with AoE magic damage + slow.

Q.name: Cosmic Binding
Q.desc: Skillshot that stuns if it hits a second enemy/wall behind first.

W.name: Caretaker's Shrine
W.desc: Place healing shrine. Heals more over time.

E.name: Magical Journey
E.desc: Create portal through terrain. Allies and enemies can use it.

R.name: Tempered Fate
R.desc: AoE stasis on everything in target area (allies, enemies, turrets).

champions.playstyle: Roaming support. Collect chimes for scaling. Q stun, E portals for creative plays. R for game-changing stasis.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
champions.title: the Great Steam Golem

passive.name: Mana Barrier
passive.desc: At low HP, gain shield equal to % mana.

Q.name: Rocket Grab
Q.desc: Hook skillshot that pulls enemy to you.

W.name: Overdrive
W.desc: Gain AS + MS burst.

E.name: Power Fist
E.desc: Next AA knocks target up.

R.name: Static Field
R.desc: Passive: AA zaps for magic. Active: AoE silence + magic damage.

champions.playstyle: Pick support. Land Q hook to win fights. Q→E→R combo deletes squishies.

champions.name: Brand
champions.title: the Burning Vengeance

passive.name: Blaze
passive.desc: Abilities apply Blaze stacks. At 3 stacks, target explodes for %max HP magic damage.

Q.name: Sear
Q.desc: Skillshot fireball. Stuns Blazed targets.

W.name: Pillar of Flame
W.desc: Delayed AoE. Deals bonus damage to Blazed targets.

E.name: Conflagration
E.desc: Targeted fire that spreads to nearby Blazed enemies.

R.name: Pyroclasm
R.desc: Bouncing fireball that prioritizes Blazed enemies. More bounces in groups.

champions.playstyle: AoE damage mage. Stack Blaze for %HP explosion. R bounces in teamfights.

champions.name: Braum
champions.title: the Heart of the Freljord

passive.name: Concussive Blows
passive.desc: AAs + ally AAs stack marks. At 4 stacks, stun target.

Q.name: Winter's Bite
Q.desc: Skillshot slow + applies passive mark.

W.name: Stand Behind Me
W.desc: Dash to ally, granting both bonus armor/MR.

E.name: Unbreakable
E.desc: Raise shield that blocks first projectile + reduces damage from that direction.

R.name: Glacial Fissure
R.desc: AoE line knockup + slow zone.

champions.name: Caitlyn
champions.title: the Sheriff of Piltover

passive.name: Headshot
passive.desc: Every 6th AA is empowered. Enhanced from brush or traps/net.

Q.name: Piltover Peacemaker

W.name: Yordle Snap Trap
W.desc: Place trap. Enemies stepping on it are rooted + take headshot.

E.name: 90 Caliber Net
E.desc: Dash backward + fire net dealing magic damage + slow.

R.name: Ace in the Hole
R.desc: Long-range targeted shot. Can be body-blocked by allies.

champions.name: Camille
champions.title: the Steel Shadow

passive.name: Adaptive Defenses
passive.desc: AA on champion grants shield (AD or AP based on target's damage type).

Q.name: Precision Protocol
Q.desc: 2-part AA enhance. Second hit deals bonus true damage after delay.

W.name: Tactical Sweep

E.name: Hookshot
E.desc: Dash to wall, then leap off wall. Stuns if you hit champion.

R.desc: Leap to target champion, locking them in a zone they cannot leave.

champions.name: Corki
champions.title: the Daring Bombardier

passive.name: Hextech Munitions
passive.desc: AAs deal bonus magic damage (converts portion to magic).

Q.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Q.desc: AoE magic damage + reveal. Long range poke.

W.name: Valkyrie
W.desc: Dash forward leaving fire trail.

E.name: Gatling Gun
E.desc: Cone DPS dealing physical + magic. Shreds armor/MR.

R.name: Missile Barrage

champions.name: Darius
champions.title: the Hand of Noxus

W.desc: AA reset dealing bonus damage + slow.

E.name: Apprehend

R.name: Noxian Guillotine
R.desc: Leap and execute. Resets on kill. True damage scaling with bleed stacks.

champions.name: Diana
champions.title: Scorn of the Moon
